CONTROLLER SWITCH
REM Farm Spirhalite Shards, Spirhalite Gems, Rare Items, and XP in Splatoon Raiders

REM A certain build and setup is required for this farm to work. Please read the following instructions carefully.

REM You need to equip an Ultra Speed Tank build with the following three gadgets equipped:
REM L: Jump Bomb. Required Mods: Jump Power Up (Large), Double Trouble
REM A: Torqscrew. Required Mods: Mega Power Egg Collection, Vortex Horizontal Area Up (+100%), Duration Up (+60%) Forbidden Mods: Delivery Distance
REM R: Dash Bomb. Required Mods: Jump Bump (Small), Double Trouble

The following Relic abilities are recommended as well: Lifesaver, Mega Power Egg Collector. DO NOT equip Speed Up

REM Be sure to also disable motion controls in settings. I recommend you save all this to one of your presets.

REM Go to the Treasure Map and select Awlmun Den on Oftu Island (east side of map near equator).
REM Hover over your intended spice level (recommend Super Spicy), then start the script.

REPEAT START

DELAY 1000

REM Start the level
PRESS A
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 6400

REM Approach the tower
PUSH Y
PUSH LS_UP
DELAY 2500
PUSH ZL
DELAY 200
PUSH LS_RIGHT
DELAY 1200
RELEASE LS_RIGHT
DELAY 700
PUSH LS_LEFT
DELAY 1300
RELEASE LS_LEFT
DELAY 1500
PUSH LS_RIGHT
DELAY 1000
RELEASE LS_RIGHT
DELAY 1400
RELEASE ZL
RELEASE LS_UP
PRESS X
DELAY 1500

REM Jump up to the top of the tower and kill the enemies
PRESS B
DELAY 200
PRESS B
DELAY 1000
PRESS L
DELAY 1000
PRESS L
DELAY 1000
PRESS R
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
PRESS R
DELAY 7000

REM Adjust to get the treasure
PUSH LS_DOWN
DELAY 150
RELEASE LS_DOWN
PUSH LS_LEFT
DELAY 500
RELEASE ALL
DELAY 12500

REM Collect treasure and return to base
PRESS A
DELAY 1500
PRESS A
DELAY 3000
PRESS A
DELAY 2000
PRESS A
DELAY 2000

REM Select the level again
PRESS X
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 1000
PRESS A
DELAY 1000
PRESS A

REM Repeat
REPEAT END
